Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited about piloting Redwood across our accelerator cohort (starts May). Two quick asks from our side before we finalize the SOW: 

1) Can SparkLane combine the "cohort promo" (the free credits you normally give startups) with a short-term committed Dedicated discount for the cohort? Our partners are asking for a predictable price for the 3-month program and the cohort credits are an important incentive for founders.

2) How will the promo credits show up on the invoice? We need to understand whether credits reduce billed consumption line-items or appear as a separate contra line (for our accounting team).

I've attached the cohort terms and a headcount/usage estimate for May–Jul. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Asha / Grace —

Putting some concrete options on the table based on the cohort numbers Asha shared:

Option A (simple): 3-month committed Dedicated discount at 15% off published committed rates. Cohort promo credits applied first; once credits hit zero, the committed rate applies. Credits do not convert to cash and are non-transferable.

Option B (blended cap): Same 15% committed discount, but we add a blended unit-price cap for the first 3 months such that after credits are applied the effective unit price for the cohort does not exceed an agreed $X per 1k tokens (we'll calculate based on your usage table). This protects founders from bill spikes.

Operational notes:
- We can accommodate either option but need to list the promo credit amount and a clear expiration date in Exhibit A of the SOW.
- If SparkLane needs credits to appear as a separate line item on the invoice, finance (Mina) will require a short memo.

I'll draft the pricing sheet and post it to the deal record: https://app.redwood.com/deals/SL-2025-045 — expect that by Mon EOD.

—Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Asha Patel <asha@sparklane.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 Mar 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Promo credits + committed discount for SparkLane cohort

Hi all —

Thanks for looping me in. A few finance points so SparkLane can plan: 

1) Invoice treatment: our standard is to show consumption at list rates and then a separate "promo credit" line that reduces the total (we record the credit as contra-revenue for accounting). If SparkLane requires a netted line (i.e., show only the net after credits), we can support that but it adds reconciliation overhead for both sides.

2) Contracting / SOW: we need the exhibit to state the exact credit quantum (USD value), the expiration date, and whether credits apply to embeddings/generation or both. Also note whether credits are refundable/transferable (they can't be).

3) Tax / compliance: if SparkLane is a reseller and intends to pass credits to founders, we need to know whether they will invoice founders separately; that affects VAT treatment in some jurisdictions. For US-headquartered SparkLane the usual treatment is straightforward but please flag if non-US founders will be on the same invoice.

4) For accounting, if SparkLane prefers credits to be held in an escrow-like construct (we've done this once before), we will need a short account-level agreement and a Finance sign-off. That route delays invoice automation by ~1 billing cycle.

If you can provide the final credit amount and preferred invoice format by Tue EOD, I can sign off and we can route the SOW to DocuSign.

Best,
Mina Haddad
VP, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
